phrase: a Produce Quality Testing Device Business
verdict: Maybe, for a hardware and data team. qZense Labs pitched a device to check the freshness of farm produce on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Traders, retailers and exporters want quick, objective quality checks, but they buy slowly and need proof of accuracy.
angle: Quality checks on produce, fish and meat are still done by eye and smell. Handheld sensors give objective grades, which helps buyers and sellers agree prices. Large retailers, exporters and processors are the likeliest first customers.
